run_compute_cfr_plus_values: run CFR-plus algorithm on a game tree for a given number of steps and return best response values for both players
run_compute_cfr_values: run standard CFR algorithm on a game tree for a given number of steps and return best response values for both players
test_compute_reach_probabilities: test computing reach probabilities for all information states in a game tree via DFS traversal
build_compute_best_response_policy: build a best response policy for an infostate by finding the action with maximum counterfactual value
summarize_counterfactual_regret_minimiza: summarize one iteration of CFR or CFR-plus with alternating or simultaneous player updates
